newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Gnomon signs 5.0bln hospital deal.
newsitem.headline: Greek Gnomon signs 5.0bln hospital deal.

text.p: Greek construction company Gnomon said on Monday it signed a 5.0 billion drachma contract on Friday to build a general hospital in Pyrgos in the Peloponnese.
IMEC GmbH will supply the basic medical equipment, estimated at 1.5 billion drachmas, Gnomon said.
The project is expected to be completed in three years, bringing Gnomon's orderbook of uncompleted projects to 20 billion drachmas, it added.
The firm expects 1997 pretax profits to rise 15 percent to 1.165 billion drachmas on turnover growth of 25 percent to 9.0 billion drachmas.

It is presently in the midst of its 1.44 billion drachma rights issue -- 1.8 million new common registered shares at 800 drachmas each. Rights entitle shareholders to three new shares per 10 outstanding.
Subscriptions for the rights issue started on June 17 and will end on July 17. Rights are trading on the Athens bourse. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
